show.description: "Mera Gaon Wala Billionaire" is a gripping microdrama that follows Malhar, a humble man who appears to be a simple egg seller but is secretly a trillionaire with immense power. After being mistreated and falsely accused by a wealthy socialite, he is saved by Vidya, a delivery girl who is also a widow facing abuse from her own greedy in-laws . Their lives intertwine when they are forced into an arranged marriage, leading Vidya to discover Malhar’s hidden empire while he uses his resources to protect her and deliver poetic justice to those who wronged them. The series explores themes of hidden identity, ultimate revenge, and the triumph of quiet dignity over arrogant wealth
